payload.headline: Two leads lost their request socket and cannot be stopped; both wait on an abandoned land

parts.cause: Their socket files under /run/user/1000/fgos/ are gone (run supervisor exited). I ran fgos session stop for both: stop-not-ended after 30 s; fgos session start then only fronted the old holder. fgos git recover fails inside a head with git-floor-probe-failed (EROFS) on the active release; the forwarding window is in 0004 phase 2, landed but not activated.

options.does: You close the two lead panes (or kill their head processes), run fgos git recover for the abandoned lands from outside the sandbox, then tell me; next wake I start both leads fresh.
options.gain: Both plans move today on the current release.
options.harm: Needs your time once at the terminal.
options.label: You end both panes and run recovery

options.does: You build and activate a release that contains 0004 phase 2, so the window forwards git recover; you still end the two panes.
options.gain: Heads can settle abandoned lands themselves from now on.
options.harm: A release change during live work; untested activation path.
options.label: Activate a release with 0004 phase 2

options.does: I park phase 6 of both plans with this reason and admit nothing that overlaps.
options.label: Park both plans

parts.recommendation: End the two panes and run the recovery yourself: it is the only path that does not need a new release, and a restarted lead resumes from its phase table.
